_comment: Shape: flat { string: string } map. Reserved keys start with _. Routed user ids never start with _. _owner = the node owner's user id (the RIVETOS_USER_ID value that still means the owner). _comment is documentation, not a user. Non-_ keys are the source of truth for known users and map user ids to profile basenames (users/<profile>.md). On first contact with a new routed id, set/create "<id>": "<id>" (repair a desynced value to the basename) and create users/<id>.md from USER-TEMPLATE.md. Keep in sync as you learn names. A missing or empty map is fail-safe: never lock anyone out, never disclose owner context to a guest.
